title: LogoColorBridge
features:
LOGO COLOR BRIDGE 🦑
The most lethal and stable Slap script available.

🔥 MAIN FEATURES
GIGA-HITBOX MAGNET – Increases your weapon's reach to massive proportions. If they are in your sight, they are getting hit.

AUTO-STICK BEHIND TP – Instantly teleports you behind the victim’s back. Stay out of their sight while sending them to the moon.

SAFE-POSITIONING – Vertical offset prevents you from touching the "Kill-Zones" or dying from player collisions.

SERVER-EVENT OVERCLOCK – Sends double damage requests to the server for instant, high-velocity knockbacks.

TOTAL VELOCITY CONTROL – Built-in anti-inertia system. You stop moving the millisecond you teleport to ensure a 100% hit rate.
